does: Starts the loading of a prepared dummy: when the dummy has a visual resource (0x54) it asks the visual system to load the visual, or reloads one that exists, then loads the physics and sets the physics group. The third parameter is a shared pointer to a callback object that is called when the visual load ends.

evidence.says: The visual branch calls the dummy's internal visual load with the callback, the physics branch reads ls::PhysicsComponent and the level's physics scene at 0x30 of the current level; the Toolkit's ecl::TLPreviewDummyHelpers::LoadDummy(WorldView&, TLPreviewDummy*, SharedPtr<Callback<void(bool)>> const&) has the same three parameters.
A probe while a dialog starts records 27 calls, one for each dummy that has something to load, each with the dummy returned by CreateDummy.
